limitations: The Linux host cannot execute D3D12 or Metal; their CTest registrations and target dependencies are covered by source and catalog-contract review and require their platform hosts for physical execution.

The CUDA device-profile test's generated multi-wall rest-stability failure predates F5-21 and is already recorded by F7-06 and F5-17; it is a physics/device-profile defect rather than layer discovery, and no test skipped because the layer was absent.
